scripts.start:backend: cd backend && npm install && node index.js
scripts.start:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev
scripts.migrate: cd backend && npm install && npx sequelize-cli db:migrate
scripts.migrate:undo: cd backend && npm install && npx sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo
scripts.migrate:undo:all: cd backend && npm install && npx sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo:all
